text:
Lina Chen: hey team, first-week kube question. Onboarding wrote ~/.kube/redwood-kc and I did `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/redwood-kc`. `kubectl auth can-i create pods -n team-ml` returns yes but `kubectl auth can-i impersonate users` returns no. thought devs had impersonate for debugging?
Omar (infra): welcome Lina! we do not grant impersonate by default. impersonate is dangerous (can act as other users). what are you debugging that needs impersonation?
Lina Chen: trying to repro an operator bug that spawns pods under a serviceaccount. impersonating the SA makes it much easier to see exact RBAC behavior.
Ava (devex): quick context: impersonation requires a Role/ClusterRole with the `impersonate` verb bound to your user (ClusterRoleBinding). usually we give short-lived access or a dedicated debug SA.
Omar (infra): process is: open a ticket in #support with the RBAC tag. include namespace, duration, justification, and whether cluster-scope is needed. For operator debug we typically grant a namespaced RoleBinding for 2-4 hours.
Lina Chen: ok filing ticket. also, `kubectl get ns` doesn't show team-ml at all on my view. onboarding said namespace would be available. did I miss something?
Ava (devex): onboarding intentionally doesn't create team namespaces automatically. infra requires an owners/CLA and repo link. we can create a personal sandbox immediately if you need one.
Lina Chen: could someone spin up a lina-sandbox in staging so I can reproduce quickly?
Omar (infra): done: created `lina-sandbox` in redwood-staging and bound you as admin for 4 hours. I added note in the support ticket with the temporary token location.
Lina Chen: thanks! one last tiny thing: my kubeconfig user is `lina@company` but my git/email is `lina.dev@personal`. will that break RBAC mapping?
Omar (infra): RBAC is based on the identity from our OIDC/SSO provider (the user field in the kubeconfig). if those differ, we map by the kube identity. if you need to change, contact SSO or your manager for a synced identity.
Onboard Bot: :white_check_mark: Onboarding task `kube:namespace` flagged for manual review for Lina Chen.
SRE Oncall: FYI if you need secret access in the sandbox for repro ping me and include ticket id.
Lina Chen: great, filing ticket and digging in now. appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
